scenarios.description: Three demonstration scenarios with different implementation levels
scenarios.disclaimer: All scenarios use synthetic data. Numbers do not represent actual PhilHealth performance.

low.name: Low Implementation & Utilization

financials.calculation: 150 claims × (65% × ₱9,000 + 35% × ₱16,000) = ₱1,717,500 billed; × 88% approval × 85% avg reimbursement = ₱1,284,690 approved; × 98% disbursement = ₱1,258,996 disbursed

low.description: Simulates early implementation phase with limited facility engagement

moderate.name: Moderate Implementation & Utilization

financials.calculation: 600 claims × (60% × ₱9,000 + 40% × ₱16,000) = ₱7,080,000 billed; × 92% approval × 85% avg reimbursement = ₱5,536,560 approved; × 98% disbursement = ₱5,425,829 disbursed

moderate.description: Simulates mid-stage implementation with growing participation

high.name: High Implementation & Utilization

financials.calculation: 2000 claims × (55% × ₱9,000 + 45% × ₱16,000) = ₱24,300,000 billed; × 95% approval × 85% avg reimbursement = ₱19,622,250 approved; × 98% disbursement = ₱19,229,805 disbursed

high.description: Simulates mature implementation with strong facility engagement

regionalDistribution.disclaimer: Regional distributions are simulated and do not represent actual geographic patterns

neutral.name: Neutral Distribution
neutral.description: Equal implementation rates across all regions

differentiated.name: Differentiated Distribution
differentiated.description: Simulated urban-rural variation (NCR higher, rural regions lower)
differentiated.note: Simulated pattern only - not based on actual regional data

notes: All rates display 'N/A' when denominator is zero

Facility counts never mixed with claim counts in rate calculations
